name: auto-improve
oneLiner: A GAN-style self-improvement loop for any text artifact: mutate, judge independently, keep only verified wins.
what_it_is: Point it at a file in a git repo. It mutates the file, grades each candidate with a separate judge model against a rubric, then a debiased pairwise gate keeps only edits that beat the champion 2-0 in shuffled orderings. Every kept change is a git commit.
audience: developers and writers who distrust one-shot LLM rewrites
pain: Asking an LLM to improve your text produces confident rewrites you cannot verify; slop ships.
differentiator: The model that mutates never grades; a double-blind pairwise gate reverts confident-but-worse rewrites. The git history is the proof.

proof.note: this video's own skill doc, 8 iterations, 4 verified keeps, today

cta.headline: every commit a verified gain
cta.action: Open source. Point it at your file.
